config.source:
SELECT test_name, MAKE_DATE(year, month, 1) AS test_month, s.result_status, s.tests
FROM adb_medsync.gold.lab_test_trends
LATERAL VIEW STACK(3,
  'Normal', total_tests - abnormal_test_count - critical_test_count,
  'Abnormal', abnormal_test_count,
  'Critical', critical_test_count) s AS result_status, tests

dimensions.name: day_type
dimensions.expr: CASE WHEN is_weekend THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END

dimensions.name: age_band
dimensions.expr:
CASE
  WHEN age < 18 THEN '0-17'
  WHEN age < 35 THEN '18-34'
  WHEN age < 50 THEN '35-49'
  WHEN age < 65 THEN '50-64'
  ELSE '65+'
END

lines: Lab testing activity across 50 hospitals, Jan 2025 - Sep 2026. Rates = abnormal (or critical) tests / total tests.
